data_quality: Partial — company-level (Newmont global, 2024) for environmental metrics; sector-level benchmarks available via Phase 1 Foran source

sources.notes: Company-level operational metrics for ore processing environmental performance. Third-party verified.

ndc_notes.C_parameter_water: 71% water recycling rate (2024) vs 65% baseline (2018). Improvement in circular resource integration — C-parameter trend is positive at Phase 2.
ndc_notes.D_natural_cyanide: 30 cyanide spills in 2024 (-33% year-on-year for high-concentration events). Cyanide management is an irreducible D-natural constraint of heap-leach and carbon-in-pulp processing. Cannot be eliminated, only reduced. Part of Path to Zero Cyanide Spills program.
ndc_notes.data_gaps: No throughput volumes, recovery rates, treatment costs, or reagent consumption data in current schema. These are the primary N-state metrics for Phase 2 and remain MISSING.
